row.title: Row
row.description: Position of this record in the file you gave us, counting from 1 — so you can go straight back to it.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: good = matches every criterion you declared. rejected = a criterion you declared is provably not met. duplicate = same record as an earlier row. undecidable = we could not prove either way, and you are not charged for it.

charged.title: Charged
charged.description: Whether this record counted towards your bill. False for every undecidable record: we do not charge for what we cannot prove.

reasons.title: Why
reasons.description: Empty when the verdict is good. Otherwise one entry per criterion this record failed.

code.description: duplicate = already seen. empty = a field you required is missing. filter = a criterion you declared is not met. email = the address cannot receive mail.

field.description: The field this reason is about. Absent on duplicate.

detail.description: Present on email reasons: what was found, in words.

firstSeenAt.description: Present on duplicate reasons: the zero-based index of the row this one duplicates.

rule.description: Present on filter reasons: the criterion you declared, echoed back exactly as you gave it.

warnings.title: Worth knowing
warnings.description: Things worth knowing that did NOT decide the verdict — a role address such as info@ is a legitimate lead for many buyers, so we flag it instead of rejecting it for you.

verdicts.title: Verdicts
verdicts.description: One row per record you gave us, with the verdict, whether it was charged, and why.
